home_court.pin_source: official league standings, HOME column summed over all 30 clubs (102-94 in 196 home games)
home_court.hca_formula: Phi^-1(home win rate) x sd(home margin): the rate from the standings (n = 196), the spread from the verified finals (n = 23). Neither estimator may move this number.
home_court.why_pinned: fitting HCA inside a short log lets the ratings absorb the season's luck; the brief pins it to the measured rate, so it is measured once and used twice
home_court.readings_note: the finals log is 23 games and its Wilson interval is wide; the standings measurement covers the whole league to date and is the pin. The gap is published, not averaged away.

data_rounds_2026_11_16.basis: measured on the finals in that capture only

data_app_ledger_constant.note: the value every sealed entry in that chain records; it is a constant, not a measurement recomputed per game day

effect_on_this_builds_lines.reading: every home margin in this build is this many points smaller than the same model run at the previously pinned value; the number moved because the pin moved from a 23-final sample to the whole league's home/away split

estimator_a.name: Massey ratings on verified final margins, pinned HCA, ridge chosen by leave-one-game-out
estimator_a.inputs_used: final margins only: no efficiency data, no availability data
estimator_a.atl_mil_note: 0022600243 (ATL @ MIL) is included: the final 113-106 is confirmed by the scoreboard, the game-book recap line and the box-score team totals. Only its quarter split is disputed, and estimator A uses margins, not quarters.

stability_across_the_ridge_sweep.why: 23 verified finals cannot determine 30 club ratings on its own; the ridge is the only thing holding the system up, so the page prints how much tonight's numbers move when the ridge moves. A line that shifts by more than the disagreement cap under this test is not a number anyone should bet, and it is not published as one.

estimator_b.name: possessions x points-per-possession from the official advanced table, with the minutes-redistribution availability adjustment
estimator_b.formula: poss = mean(possessions per game of the two clubs); pts_t = poss x ((off_rtg_t - availability_delta_t) + def_rtg_opp) / 2 / 100; margin = pts_home - pts_away + pinned hca; total = pts_home + pts_away

totals_model.rejected: the average of the two clubs' scoring averages
totals_model.why: a scoring average already contains the pace the team actually played and the opponent it faced; adding two of them makes a total that no single game implies. Both are printed for every row so the difference is auditable.

injury_coverage.rule: one official injury filing state per club per game, read from the newest revision; a club the report does not cover for that date is 'unknown', never 'clear'

luck_formula: expected wins = GP x Phi(net_rtg / sd(home margin from the verified finals)); z = (wins - expected) / sqrt(GP x p x (1 - p)). sd = 17.62 points
luck_rule: |z| > 2.0 keeps a club out of any bet-eligible row on this site

pricing.rho_method: both rhos are measured on the verified finals in this repo: margin against total, and the margin of one game against the margin of another game on the same date. Nothing is assumed from another league or season.
pricing.leg_probability_method: p(favourite covers our line) = Phi(|edge| / residual sd); p(over our total) = Phi(|our total - league mean total| / sd total)
pricing.copula: Gaussian: p_parlay = Phi2(Phi^-1(p1), Phi^-1(p2); rho). The naive price p1 x p2 is printed beside it on every row, so the correlation effect is visible, not hidden.
